briefs.claim_en: Prime Minister Modi is offering all Indians 3 months of free mobile recharge.
briefs.brief_en: Multiple fact-checking organizations and news outlets, including Hindustan Times, Telugu Post, The Quint, LatestLY, Prabhat Khabar, BOOM, Vishvas News, FACTLY, and ThePrint, report that claims of Prime Minister Modi offering free mobile recharge to all Indians are false. These claims have circulated widely, often through viral messages and digitally altered videos, sometimes linked to events like the Lok Sabha Elections or Raksha Bandhan. The Press Information Bureau (PIB) has clarified that neither the Indian Government nor PM Modi is running any such scheme, warning that associated links may lead to data theft and scams. Fact-checkers have consistently debunked these claims, advising users not to click on suspicious links.
